name: Slovenia

authorities.competent_authority: JAZMP (Javna agencija Republike Slovenije za zdravila in medicinske pripomočke, Agency for Medicinal Products and Medical Devices): validation, scientific assessment, national coordination and notification of the decision.
authorities.ethics: KME RS (Komisija Republike Slovenije za medicinsko etiko, Commission of the Republic of Slovenia for Medical Ethics) is the competent ethics committee for the Clinical Trials Regulation in Slovenia and prepares the Part II assessment. A separate pre-submission ethics opinion is not a substitute for the CTIS assessment.
authorities.fee: The sponsor pays one combined national procedure fee to JAZMP under the current JAZMP tariff; JAZMP allocates the KME RS portion. Follow the current JAZMP payment instructions for the application type and retain proof of payment. No second standalone KME RS payment for a CTIS application unless an authority instruction for the specific procedure expressly requires it (SI-FEE).
authorities.national_guidance: Regulation implementing the EU Clinical Trials Regulation, Official Gazette RS No 132/2022 (Articles 2, 5 to 10 and 14 to 15); Patients' Rights Act, Official Gazette RS No 15/2008 (Articles 35 and 37); KME RS Instructions for Preparing Applications for Ethical Assessment, 3 March 2020 (points 10 to 13); KME RS Form of Voluntary and Informed Consent After Information (one-page model, reference only); KME RS official clinical-trial page (updated 21 April 2026); Information Commissioner opinion on clinical trials and data-protection legal bases; European Commission Q&A on Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 (July 2026); EudraLex Volume 10 Part II templates (version 2.0 transition effective 1 September 2026); as recorded in the Slovenia guides reviewed 23 September 2026.

answer_languages_note: One package language, Slovenian. Part II forms are answered in Slovenian (the supplied Slovenian variable sheet targets Slovenian for every variable). Administrative Part II documents may also be in English (DECISIONS.md D1). The Slovenia guides and the supplied CTIS_SI set state no Italian or Hungarian requirement for any document, including for sites in the bilingual areas; no Italian or Hungarian version is planned (DECISIONS.md D2).

language_rules.rule: The national implementing regulation allows the application dossier in Slovenian or English with three exceptions: the cover letter must be in Slovenian; a Slovenian protocol synopsis with the nationally specified short description is mandatory (current EU language guidance calls for both English and Slovenian synopsis versions in a multinational application); and every document intended for participants must be in Slovenian (PIS, ICF, recruitment material, participant cards, instructions, questionnaires completed by participants, diaries, age-specific information, legal-representative documents and optional-consent materials).
language_rules.translation_quality: Natural Slovenian terminology and short sentences; technical terms defined; a literal translation is not adequate without clinical and linguistic review; the Slovenian text is reviewed by a competent native-language clinical reviewer and a traceable translation and review record is kept.
language_rules.interpreters: A person who does not understand Slovenian receives competent interpretation and translated or orally interpreted information as approved; the language and interpreter are recorded. An interpreter does not replace an impartial witness or a legally designated representative, and a witness does not cure an untranslated document.
language_rules.minority_languages: The Slovenia guides (11 pages under /ctis/slovenia/en/) and the supplied CTIS_SI set contain no Italian or Hungarian language requirement, and the variable sheet targets Slovenian only. Nothing is planned in Italian or Hungarian; the question is open for sites in the bilingual areas (DECISIONS.md D2).
language_rules.form_answers: Shared EU forms (content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Slovenian; English is also accepted for these administrative documents (DECISIONS.md D1).

study_facts_country_specific.application.multinational: Is the application multinational? (Then the protocol synopsis is needed in English and Slovenian, SI-D1-SYNOPSIS.)
study_facts_country_specific.reproductive.teratogenic_risk: Does the investigational product carry a teratogenic or reproductive risk? (KME RS guidance: written pregnancy and fetal-risk information, contraception instructions and a signed acknowledgment by women of childbearing potential, and the same warning for healthy female partners of male participants.)
study_facts_country_specific.screening.research_procedures_before_mai: Do invasive procedures or identifiable health-data collection begin before main consent (for example a healthy-volunteer screening phase)? (Then a Slovenian screening consent is needed.)

documents.language_rule: Slovenian or English (administrative assessment document, not participant-facing); answers in this form in Slovenian.

template.basis: Current European Commission recruitment and informed-consent procedure template, version 2.0 (applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026, including initial applications, additional Member States and Part II submissions completing an Article 11 application)

documents.signature_rule: Not signed by future participants. The current EU template does not require a Slovenian national signature form.
documents.content: How potential participants are identified, approached, informed, given time to decide and consented. Complete the Member State fields for Slovenia. Every population pathway in the plan (minors with the 15-year threshold and justified age and maturity groupings, adults unable to consent, impartial witness, emergency) needs its section completed; the age and maturity logic for minors is documented here.

national_fields.v105: Required in Slovenia: in Slovenian, state that every recruitment advertisement, invitation, social-media text, video script, call-centre script or other material that participants will see or hear is submitted under Recruitment arrangements in its final Slovenian version (non-print content as final-form text or a sufficiently complete representation) before use; that recruitment claims match the approved Participant Information Sheet and the financial document and payment is not the dominant message; and, for healthy volunteers, how recruitment advertisements and screening invitations are used and what data are collected and retained at a brief eligibility contact.
national_fields.v108: Required in Slovenia: in Slovenian, state that the Participant Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form are provided in Slovenian; that a suitably qualified member of the trial team conducts the consent interview, allows sufficient time and confirms understanding rather than relying only on a signature; that the participant or legally designated representative and the person conducting the interview personally sign and date the consent record, signed in the investigator's presence and prepared in two copies, one for the participant and one for the trial archive (KME RS guidance); that the participant receives the written information and a signed and dated copy; that an interpreter may support comprehension but does not replace an impartial witness or a legally designated representative; that genuinely optional activities have separate statements and signature boxes; that consent to take part in the trial is not treated automatically as the GDPR legal basis for data processing (Information Commissioner); where teratogenic risk exists, that women of childbearing potential, and healthy female partners of male participants where relevant, sign an acknowledgment of the written pregnancy, fetal-risk and contraception information (KME RS guidance, point 12); and how re-consent is obtained after material new information, at adulthood, after regained capacity and for a newly proposed optional use.
national_fields.v110: Required in Slovenia when adults unable to consent are included: in Slovenian, describe who assesses capacity, when it is reassessed and how fluctuating capacity is managed (capacity is decision-specific; inability to read or write, a physical disability or the need for an interpreter is not incapacity); how the legally designated representative is identified and their documented legal authority verified (Patients' Rights Act, Article 37; KME RS guidance refers to a close person or legal representative, but an informal family relationship does not replace documented legal authority where the CTR requires a legally designated representative); that where no representative exists the healthcare provider informs the competent authority so that one can be appointed; that the representative decides according to the participant's presumed wishes and interests; how the participant receives information suited to their understanding and how assent, cooperation, refusal or dissent is recorded and respected; how each Article 31 condition is met; and the participant's own express consent when capacity is regained.
national_fields.v114: Required in Slovenia when minors are included: in Slovenian, state that the legally designated representative gives the legally effective trial consent for every participant under 18; that under the Patients' Rights Act (Article 35) a child under 15 is presumed unable, and a child aged 15 or older presumed able, to consent to healthcare unless the doctor assesses otherwise, and that KME RS guidance requires the own agreement of invited minors aged 15 or older in addition to the consent of the parents or representative; explain and justify the age and maturity groupings below 15 and their documents (no fixed national bands below 15); how legal authority for the particular child and family circumstances is verified (a person accompanying the child is not automatically authorised); that information is given by a person trained or experienced in working with children; how assent and agreement are recorded; that an explicit refusal or wish to withdraw of a minor capable of forming an opinion is respected; and the participant's express informed consent on reaching 18.
national_fields.v117: Required in Slovenia when an impartial witness may be needed: in Slovenian, state that a witness is used only when the participant or legally designated representative can consent but cannot write (Article 29 CTR), and not because of an interpreter need, limited vision that an accessible signature method solves, lack of capacity, an unavailable representative or to shorten the interview; how a witness independent of the trial team is selected (not the interviewer or recruiter, no direct financial interest in enrolment, close family avoided where dependence or conflict could undermine impartiality); that the witness is present for the whole information and consent process; whether the approved procedure lets an interpreter also act as witness, with each role documented; and that the reason the person cannot write, the witness's name and role, and the date and time are recorded.
national_fields.v121: Required in Slovenia when emergency enrolment is used: in Slovenian, explain each Article 35 condition for the specific emergency condition and therapeutic window; why prior consent of the participant and representative cannot be obtained; how prior objections and advance information are checked; the intervention permitted before consent; who makes and records the enrolment decision and what is recorded; the later information and consent, without undue delay, of the participant or legally designated representative, and the participant's own consent when capacity returns; handling of refusal, withdrawal, data and samples and the right to object to the use of data; site training, round-the-clock availability and oversight; and that no Slovenian national emergency-consent form or waiver applies and the KME RS general urgent-action process is not a substitute for the CTIS-approved pathway.

documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek K (Recruitment arrangements). Obvezen dokument. Upravni dokument: dovoljena je slovenščina ali angleščina; odgovori v tej predlogi so v slovenščini. Prihodnji udeleženci ga ne podpišejo; veljavna predloga EU ne zahteva slovenskega nacionalnega obrazca za podpis. Osnova: predloga Evropske komisije »Recruitment and informed consent procedure«, različica 2.0 (velja za nove predložitve dela II od 1. septembra 2026, tudi za začetne vloge, dodatne države članice in dopolnitve vlog po členu 11). Izpolnite polja države članice za Slovenijo (glej national_fields). Za vsako populacijo z lastno potjo soglasja (mladoletniki, odrasli, ki ne morejo dati soglasja, nepristranska priča, nujne situacije) izpolnite ustrezni razdelek, sicer navedite, da se ne uporablja. Pri mladoletnikih opišite prag 15 let in utemeljite starostne skupine in skupine glede na zrelost pod 15 let (nacionalne skupine niso določene).

documents.trigger_text: Each recruitment advertisement, invitation, social-media text, video script, call-centre script or other material that participants will see or hear.
documents.content: Final-form Slovenian text, or a sufficiently complete representation of non-print content. Claims match the approved PIS and financial document. Healthy volunteers: do not describe the trial as a job, guaranteed income, free health check or risk-free opportunity; state the main participation burden and payment without making payment the dominant message. Material addressed to parents, children or adolescents when minors are included.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek K (Recruitment arrangements). Pogojen: vsak oglas, vabilo, besedilo za družbena omrežja, scenarij videa ali klicnega centra ali drugo gradivo, ki ga udeleženci vidijo ali slišijo; en dokument na gradivo. Obvezna je slovenska različica v končni obliki ali dovolj popoln prikaz netiskanih vsebin. Ni podpisano ob predložitvi. Trditve se morajo ujemati z odobrenimi informacijami za udeleženca in finančnim dokumentom; plačilo ne sme biti prevladujoče sporočilo; za zdrave prostovoljce preskušanja ne predstavljajte kot zaposlitev, zajamčen zaslužek, brezplačen zdravstveni pregled ali priložnost brez tveganja. Brez predloge: osnutek iz protokola in postopka novačenja (K1).

documents.name_en: Trial-specific Slovenian Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form (adults able to consent)
documents.template_status: missing: no Slovenian participant templates supplied; see population_sets (every template "missing") and DECISIONS.md D3. The KME RS one-page model consent form is a national reference only and does not replace a trial-specific PIS and ICF.
documents.signature_rule: Blank version with version number and date; not signed by the participant, legal representative, witness or investigator at CTIS submission. When consent is obtained, the participant or legally designated representative and the person conducting the interview sign and date the consent record, in the investigator's presence and in two copies (participant and trial archive) per KME RS guidance.
documents.content: Trial-specific Slovenian PIS and ICF for adults able to consent, as one integrated document or two coordinated documents with matching title, protocol identifier, EU trial number, population, version, date and site contacts (DECISIONS.md D4). Content per the Slovenia patient information and consent guide (drafting_rules). Population-specific pathways are in SI-L1-POPULATION.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek L (Subject information and informed consent form). Obvezen dokument: za preskušanje specifične informacije za udeleženca in obrazec za informirano soglasje v slovenščini za odrasle, ki lahko dajo soglasje. Naloži se prazna različica s številko različice in datumom; ob predložitvi je ne podpiše nihče. Ko se soglasje pridobi, ga udeleženec ali pravno imenovani zastopnik in oseba, ki vodi razgovor, osebno podpišeta in datirata v navzočnosti raziskovalca, v dveh izvodih (za udeleženca in za arhiv preskušanja), v skladu z navodili KME RS. Informacije in soglasje sta lahko en dokument ali dva usklajena dokumenta. Vzorčni obrazec KME RS je le referenca in ne nadomesti celotnega dokumenta. Slovenska predloga ni bila dodana: osnutek po slovenskih vodnikih (drafting_rules) ali prilagoditev referenčnega dokumenta.

documents.trigger: population.healthy_volunteers or population.minors or population.adults_without_capacity or consent.emergency_enrolment or consent.impartial_witness_possible or pregnancy.participant_follow_up_beyond_main_consent or pregnancy.partner_follow_up or pregnancy.infant_follow_up or reproductive.teratogenic_risk or screening.research_procedures_before_main_consent or samples.future_use_outside_protocol or data.future_use_outside_protocol
documents.trigger_text: A consent pathway not adequately covered by the main adult PIS and ICF: healthy volunteers, minors, adults unable to consent, emergency enrolment, a participant unable to write, pregnancy follow-up, or optional future use of data and samples.
documents.template_status: missing: no Slovenian participant templates supplied (DECISIONS.md D3).
documents.content: Separate or adapted Slovenian documents for each pathway; blank application documents signed only when the applicable consent is obtained. See population_sets and population_rules.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek L. Pogojen: ločeni ali prilagojeni slovenski dokumenti, kadar protokol vključuje pot soglasja, ki je glavni dokument za odrasle ne pokrije ustrezno (zdravi prostovoljci, mladoletniki, odrasli, ki ne morejo dati soglasja, nujne situacije, udeleženec, ki ne more pisati, spremljanje nosečnosti, neobvezna prihodnja uporaba podatkov in vzorcev). Prazni dokumenti; podpišejo se šele ob pridobitvi soglasja. Mladoletniki od 15. leta dajo lastno privolitev poleg soglasja staršev ali zastopnika (KME RS). Pripravite pravilne podpisne bloke za vsakega podpisnika le v poti, kjer se uporabljajo. Glej population_sets in population_rules; predloge niso bile dodane.

documents.trigger_text: Slovenian participant cards, dosing instructions, device instructions, diaries, questionnaires, interview guides, educational sheets, pregnancy alerts and similar materials when used. Healthy volunteers: instructions for confinement, fasting, diet, activity, medicines, alcohol, nicotine, contraception, donation restrictions, driving or follow-up.
documents.note: Protocol-driven outcome instruments stay aligned with the English version used for the common scientific assessment (Part I); the Slovenian participant version goes in the appropriate Part II category according to current CTIS guidance (DECISIONS.md D5).
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II. Pogojen: slovenske kartice udeleženca, navodila za odmerjanje in pripomočke, dnevniki, vprašalniki, vodila za intervjuje, izobraževalni listi, opozorila glede nosečnosti in podobno gradivo, kadar se uporablja. Instrumenti za opazovane izide, ki jih določa protokol, ostanejo usklajeni z angleško različico za skupno znanstveno oceno (del I); slovenska različica za udeležence se naloži v ustrezno kategorijo dela II po veljavnih navodilih CTIS (predlagano: L2 ali R2_Patient-facing document_<vrsta>_SI_sl za dokumente, povezane z opazovanimi izidi). Ni podpisano ob predložitvi.

documents.signature_rule: The CTR requires no signature on the CV at CTIS submission and no additional Slovenian CTIS signature rule was identified; do not create an unsupported signature requirement.
documents.content: Current CV of the principal investigator at each Slovenian site showing education, professional registration, relevant experience and clinical-trial competence. Slovenian law requires one principal investigator per site, a licensed physician or licensed doctor of dental medicine trained in Good Clinical Practice. Personal details come from the investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek M (Suitability of the investigator). Obvezen dokument za glavnega raziskovalca na vsakem slovenskem mestu preskušanja. Dovoljena slovenščina ali angleščina. Prikazati mora izobrazbo, strokovno registracijo, ustrezne izkušnje in usposobljenost za klinična preskušanja. Po slovenskem pravu ima vsako mesto enega glavnega raziskovalca, ki je zdravnik ali doktor dentalne medicine z licenco in usposobljen za dobro klinično prakso. Ob predložitvi CTIS podpis ni potreben; ne dodajajte nepodprte zahteve za podpis. Asistent vpiše samo naslov preskušanja in številko EU; osebne podatke da raziskovalec in se ne izmišljajo.

template.basis: EudraLex declaration-of-interest template or a document containing the same required information

documents.signature_rule: The current EU Q&A states that signatures on investigator CVs and declarations of interest are not CTR application requirements; Slovenia has not published a contrary CTIS-specific rule. Keep the document current and attributable to the investigator without presenting a signature as mandatory.
documents.content: Financial interests and institutional affiliations that could affect impartiality, stated by the investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek M (Suitability of the investigator). Obvezna izjava o interesih za vsakega glavnega raziskovalca in mesto: finančni interesi in institucionalne povezave, ki bi lahko vplivale na nepristranskost. Dovoljena slovenščina ali angleščina. Predloga EudraLex ali dokument z enakimi zahtevanimi podatki. Po veljavnih vprašanjih in odgovorih EU podpis ni zahteva vloge; Slovenija nima drugačnega pravila. Dokument naj bo aktualen in pripisljiv raziskovalcu, podpisa ne predstavljajte kot obveznega. Asistent vpiše samo naslov preskušanja in številko EU; podatke o interesih navede raziskovalec sam.

template.basis: Current EudraLex site suitability form (the guide names it for Slovenia)

documents.signature_rule: Dated and signed by the person authorised to confirm the institution's suitability (site-suitability signatures are governed by the Member State's system). The site completes and signs the issued-by block; the assistant leaves it empty.
documents.content: One statement per Slovenian site: the site, principal investigator, facilities, equipment, staffing, pharmacy and sample pathways, emergency support, participant population and ability to perform the protocol safely, plus the KME RS institutional-management confirmation.

national_fields.v125: Required in Slovenia: in Slovenian, include the confirmation of the responsible institutional management expected by KME RS guidance that the research is permitted at the institution after ethics approval, that qualified staff and safety arrangements are available, that research-only costs do not burden compulsory health insurance and that ordinary patient access will not be reduced; identify the site, the principal investigator and the participant population, and cover the pharmacy and sample pathways and emergency support.
national_fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Slovenia: date and signature of the person authorised to confirm the institution's suitability. Completed and signed by the site; the assistant leaves the block empty and does not invent the name or role.

documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields and the issued-by signature block left for the site
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek N (Suitability of the facilities). Obvezna izjava o primernosti za vsako slovensko mesto preskušanja. Dovoljena slovenščina ali angleščina. Uporabite veljavni obrazec EudraLex za primernost mesta. Opredelite mesto, glavnega raziskovalca, prostore, opremo, kadre, poti za zdravila in vzorce, podporo v nujnih primerih, populacijo udeležencev in zmožnost varne izvedbe protokola. Po navodilih KME RS odgovorno vodstvo ustanove potrdi, da je raziskava po etični odobritvi dovoljena, da so na voljo usposobljeno osebje in varnostni ukrepi, da stroški, ki nastanejo samo zaradi raziskave, ne bremenijo obveznega zdravstvenega zavarovanja in da se dostop drugih bolnikov do obravnave ne zmanjša. Izjavo datira in podpiše oseba, pooblaščena za potrditev primernosti ustanove; blok izpolni in podpiše mesto, asistent ga pusti praznega.

documents.ctis_title_supplement: O2_Proof of coverage_<sponsor or site>, only when the certificate omits essential terms and the policy wording or an explanatory guarantee is added (DECISIONS.md D8).
documents.signature_rule: Issued by the insurer or guarantor; no separate applicant signature.
documents.content: Insurance or another guarantee covering both sponsor liability and investigator liability for damage a participant suffers because of participation in a trial conducted in Slovenia, in place before trial conduct starts. The evidence lets KME RS connect the cover to the sponsor, protocol, Slovenian conduct, covered liabilities, period and any material exclusions. If the certificate omits essential terms, include the relevant policy wording or an explanatory guarantee. The guides state no minimum cover. The Slovenian PIS and ICF describe damage cover and the claim route consistently with this proof.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek O (Proof of insurance cover or indemnification). Obvezen dokument: zavarovanje ali drugo jamstvo, ki krije odgovornost naročnika in odgovornost raziskovalca za škodo, ki jo udeleženec utrpi zaradi sodelovanja v preskušanju v Sloveniji; veljati mora pred začetkom izvajanja. Dovoljena slovenščina ali angleščina. Iz dokazila mora biti razvidna povezava z naročnikom, protokolom, izvajanjem v Sloveniji, kritimi odgovornostmi, obdobjem in bistvenimi izključitvami. Če potrdilo izpušča bistvene pogoje, priložite ustrezno besedilo police ali pojasnjevalno jamstvo. Potrdilo izda zavarovalnica ali porok; ločen podpis vlagatelja ni potreben. Besedilo o zavarovanju v dokumentih za udeležence mora ustrezati dokazilu.

documents.content: Participant expense reimbursement (travel, meals, accommodation), compensation or payment and any other benefits: amount, basis, schedule, conditions and treatment after screen failure or early withdrawal, matching the Slovenian PIS. KME RS guidance supports reimbursement of participation-related direct costs and warns that the amount must not induce participation; the institution conducting the research, rather than the sponsor directly, should contract with participants for compensation. Healthy volunteers: reimbursement of expenses separated from compensation for time, inconvenience and burden; no large completion bonuses. Minors and adults unable to consent: no incentive or financial inducement beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation (Article 31 CTR). Trial financing and payments to investigators or sites: SI-P2-FINANCING.
documents.filled_by: assistant; amounts and conditions only from the sponsor's sources
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek P (Financial and other arrangements). Obvezni podatki. Dovoljena slovenščina ali angleščina; običajno brez podpisa. Navedite povračilo stroškov (potni stroški, prehrana, nastanitev), nadomestilo ali plačilo in druge ugodnosti: znesek, osnovo, časovni razpored, pogoje in ravnanje ob neuspešnem presejanju ali predčasnem odstopu; podatki morajo biti enaki kot v slovenskih informacijah za udeleženca. Po navodilih KME RS se povrnejo neposredni stroški sodelovanja, znesek pa ne sme spodbujati sodelovanja; pogodbo o nadomestilu z udeležencem sklene ustanova, ki izvaja raziskavo, in ne neposredno naročnik. Pri zdravih prostovoljcih ločite povračilo stroškov od nadomestila za čas in breme. Pri mladoletnikih in odraslih, ki ne morejo dati soglasja, ni spodbud razen povračila stroškov in izpada dohodka. Financiranje preskušanja in plačila raziskovalcem ali mestom: SI-P2-FINANCING.

documents.ctis_title_note: The naming guide gives only the P1 example; P2 is the next free P number for the financing description (DECISIONS.md D6).
documents.name_en: Trial financing and other financial arrangements
documents.content: Clear description of trial financing, payments to investigators or sites, and any arrangements that could influence recruitment or conduct. The shared P1 form covers participant compensation only, so this description is a separate upload unless the user chooses to combine it with P1 (DECISIONS.md D6).
documents.kind_note: No template supplied; the sponsor provides the financing facts (contracts, budgets). The assistant can draft the description from those sources once the format is agreed (DECISIONS.md D6).
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek P (Financial and other arrangements). Obvezni podatki: jasen opis financiranja preskušanja, plačil raziskovalcem ali mestom preskušanja in dogovorov, ki bi lahko vplivali na novačenje ali izvajanje. Dovoljena slovenščina ali angleščina; običajno brez podpisa. Skupni obrazec P1 zajema samo nadomestila udeležencem, zato je ta opis ločen dokument (predlagani naslov P2_Financial arrangements_SI). Podatke o financiranju da naročnik; zneskov in pogodb se ne izmišlja.

documents.ctis_title: R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_SI

template.basis: EudraLex statement of compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679, with the Slovenian national content added

documents.content: Statement or supporting document in the CTIS data-protection category identifying the controller arrangements, legal basis, purposes, recipients, transfers, safeguards, retention, participant rights, and compliance with the GDPR and Slovenian law. Trial-participation consent is not automatically consent for personal-data processing; the controller identifies the proper legal basis for the actual processing operations (Information Commissioner).

national_fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Required in Slovenia: in Slovenian, state that processing also complies with Slovenian law, and identify the controller or joint-controller arrangements, the legal basis for each processing purpose (consent to take part in the trial is not automatically the GDPR legal basis; Information Commissioner), the purposes, recipients, international transfers and safeguards, retention and participant rights, consistent with the Slovenian participant information. Use only the sponsor's data-protection sources; do not name a legal basis the sources do not give.

documents.filled_by: assistant; responsible person and data-protection facts from the sponsor
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek R (Compliance with national requirements on data protection). Obvezen dokument. Dovoljena slovenščina ali angleščina; brez podpisa. Poleg izjave EudraLex o skladnosti s Splošno uredbo o varstvu podatkov za Slovenijo navedite (glej national_fields): ureditev upravljavca ali skupnih upravljavcev, pravno podlago za vsak namen obdelave, namene, prejemnike, prenose in zaščitne ukrepe, hrambo, pravice udeležencev in skladnost s slovenskim pravom. Soglasje za sodelovanje v preskušanju ni samodejno pravna podlaga za obdelavo osebnih podatkov (Informacijski pooblaščenec). Ime in funkcijo odgovorne osebe naročnika ter podatke o obdelavi da naročnik; ne izmišljujte jih. Informacije za udeleženca morajo biti skladne s to izjavo.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_SI
documents.name_en: Compliance with rules for biological samples
documents.trigger_text: The trial collects, exports, stores, genetically analyses or reuses human biological samples.

template.basis: EudraLex biological-samples compliance template (may be used)

documents.content: Samples required for the trial separated from optional future use; purpose, tests, coding and key holder, storage location and duration, transfers, destruction or anonymisation, return of findings where applicable, and what withdrawal can still achieve. Participant-facing sample information and choices are in Slovenian.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: CTIS del II, razdelek S (Compliance with use of biological samples). Pogojen: kadar preskušanje zbira, izvaža, hrani, genetsko analizira ali ponovno uporablja človeške biološke vzorce. Lahko se uporabi predloga EudraLex; dokument za oceno je lahko v slovenščini ali angleščini. Ločite vzorce, potrebne za preskušanje, od neobvezne prihodnje uporabe. Opišite namen, preiskave, kodiranje, kraj in trajanje hrambe, prenose, uničenje ali anonimizacijo, vračanje izvidov, kjer je primerno, in kaj odstop še lahko doseže. Informacije in izbire za udeležence so v slovenščini in skladne s tem obrazcem.

documents.ctis_section: B (cover letter; not a Part II placeholder)
documents.ctis_title_note: Naming guide pattern B1_Cover letter_EU CT number; country and language added because the Slovenian cover letter is a national language item (DECISIONS.md D7).
documents.signature_note: The Slovenia guides set no signature rule for the cover letter.
documents.content: The cover letter must be in Slovenian. Not an ordinary Part II placeholder, but an essential Slovenia application check.
documents.kind_note: No template supplied; the sponsor issues the letter. The assistant can draft it in Slovenian from the plan once a format is agreed (DECISIONS.md D7).
documents.drafting_notes_sl: Ni običajno mesto dela II, je pa bistveno preverjanje vloge za Slovenijo: spremno pismo mora biti v slovenščini. Predlagani naslov B1_Cover letter_<številka EU>_SI_sl. Vodniki ne določajo pravila o podpisu. Podatki se morajo ujemati z vlogo in seznamom dokumentov.

documents.ctis_section: D (Part I protocol section; not a Part II placeholder)
documents.ctis_title_note: Naming guide pattern D1_Protocol synopsis_MS_EU CT number_LANGUAGE.
documents.language_rule: The Slovenian synopsis is mandatory; current EU language guidance calls for English and Slovenian synopsis versions in a multinational application (English version when application.multinational). The protocol itself may be in Slovenian or English.
documents.content: Briefly covers the purpose and scientific importance (supported by essential literature, including relevant Slovenian literature), methods including statistics, duration, participant number and ages, recruitment, inclusion and exclusion criteria, withdrawal criteria, randomisation, and ethical issues including benefits, risks and burdens (national implementing regulation, Article 10). Must not contradict the PIS.
documents.kind_note: Part I document written from the protocol; recorded and checked here because the Slovenian content rule is national. If Part I is in the plan, the assistant can draft it from the protocol (DECISIONS.md D7).
documents.drafting_notes_sl: Ni običajno mesto dela II (del I, razdelek D). Obvezen slovenski povzetek protokola; v večnacionalni vlogi tudi angleška različica. Na kratko zajame namen in znanstveni pomen (podprt z bistveno literaturo, tudi ustrezno slovensko), metode vključno s statistiko, trajanje, število in starost udeležencev, novačenje, vključitvena in izključitvena merila, merila za izstop, randomizacijo ter etična vprašanja s koristmi, tveganji in bremeni (10. člen nacionalne izvedbene uredbe). Ne sme biti v nasprotju z informacijami za udeleženca.

documents.ctis_title_note: The naming guide says proof of fee payment uses another CTIS upload location and gives no CTCG title; the guide asks to retain proof of payment and does not say whether to upload it (DECISIONS.md D9).
documents.name_en: Proof of payment of the combined national fee
documents.language_rule: The guides state no language for the payment proof.
documents.content: The sponsor pays the combined national procedure fee to JAZMP under the current JAZMP tariff; JAZMP allocates the KME RS portion. Follow the current JAZMP payment instructions for the application type and retain proof of payment. No second standalone KME RS payment unless an authority instruction for the specific procedure expressly requires it.
documents.drafting_notes_sl: Ni dokument dela II: upravna zahteva (CTIS, razdelek Forms). Naročnik plača enotno nacionalno pristojbino JAZMP po veljavni tarifi JAZMP; JAZMP razporedi delež KME RS. Upoštevajte veljavna navodila JAZMP za vrsto vloge in shranite dokazilo o plačilu. Ločenega plačila KME RS za vlogo CTIS ni, razen če ga navodilo organa za posamezni postopek izrecno zahteva.

checklist_mapping_note: One document per item of the Slovenia Part II document checklist page (items 1-13). Three items cover two separate uploads and map to two documents each: item 1 (K1 procedure and K2 recruitment material, listed as two entries on the page), item 9 (P1 participant compensation on the shared form and P2 trial financing, because the shared P1 form has no place for financing and site payments; DECISIONS.md D6) and item 12 (Slovenian cover letter and Slovenian protocol synopsis). Items 12 and 13 are outside the Part II placeholders, as the page says.

fields.v105: Required in Slovenia: Slovenian final-form recruitment material, claims matching the PIS and financial document, healthy-volunteer screening invitations and eligibility-contact data (full text on SI-K1).
fields.v108: Required in Slovenia: Slovenian PIS/ICF, qualified interviewer, signing in the investigator's presence in two copies, interpreter role, separate optional choices, trial consent not the GDPR legal basis, reproductive-risk acknowledgment, re-consent (full text on SI-K1).
fields.v110: Required in Slovenia when adults unable to consent are included: capacity assessment, legally designated representative under the Patients' Rights Act Article 37, appointment where none exists, participant involvement, Article 31 conditions, regained capacity (full text on SI-K1).
fields.v114: Required in Slovenia when minors are included: representative consent under 18, the Patients' Rights Act 15-year presumption, own agreement from 15 (KME RS), justified groupings below 15, authority verification, dissent, consent at 18 (full text on SI-K1).
fields.v117: Required in Slovenia when an impartial witness may be needed: Article 29 use only, witness independence, presence throughout, interpreter role, records (full text on SI-K1).
fields.v121: Required in Slovenia when emergency enrolment is used: each Article 35 condition, records, subsequent consent, right to object to data use, no national waiver, KME RS urgent-action process not a substitute (full text on SI-K1).

fields.v125: Required in Slovenia: KME RS institutional-management confirmation (research permitted after ethics approval, staff and safety arrangements, research-only costs not charged to compulsory health insurance, ordinary patient access not reduced) (full text on SI-N1).
fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Slovenia: date and signature of the person authorised to confirm suitability; left empty for the site.

fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Required in Slovenia: compliance with Slovenian law, controller arrangements, legal basis per purpose (trial consent is not the GDPR legal basis), purposes, recipients, transfers, safeguards, retention, rights (full text on SI-R1).

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the full text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, sponsor, authority). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

Optional future use of data and samples
participant_templates_missing.role: separate Slovenian form or clearly separated optional section with its own choice and signature

participant_templates_missing_note: No Slovenian participant templates were supplied (CTIS_SI holds only the seven Part II DOCX files and the variable sheet). Draft each participant document from the Slovenia guides (drafting_rules, population_sets notes, checklists/participant-documents.json) with styles/base.md, or adapt it from its reference-package counterpart (based_on), until a Slovenian set is supplied and split into templates/participant (DECISIONS.md D3). The guides found no Slovenia-specific CTIS template for any population (healthy volunteers, minors, limited capacity, emergency, witness, pregnancy, secondary use).

population_sets.basis: Slovenia patient information and consent guide (KME RS instructions, 3 March 2020, points 10 to 13; national implementing regulation, Article 10); no Slovenian template supplied.
population_sets.note: Trial-specific Slovenian PIS and ICF; the KME RS one-page model consent form is a reference only.

First-in-human, pharmacokinetic, bioavailability, bioequivalence, food-effect, drug-interaction or other non-therapeutic cohorts. No patient language suggesting treatment or disease benefit; separate or clearly population-specific documents when patients and healthy volunteers are both enrolled. State plainly that the person is healthy for the trial's purpose and that direct medical benefit is not expected; screening findings are not a promised benefit. First exposure: uncertainty, starting dose, sentinel dosing, escalation, stopping rules, monitoring, emergency arrangements. Payment separated from expense reimbursement; no large completion bonuses. Healthy status does not reduce the consent standard and does not justify emergency or legal-representative enrolment.

Any Slovenian screening consent if invasive procedures or identifiable health-data collection begins before main consent; obtain the approved consent before blood draws, imaging, genetic testing, washout or other material screening procedures. A brief eligibility contact only needs an explanation of what data are collected and retained (K1 v105).

Parent or legally designated representative PIS and ICF always; adolescent information and assent or agreement form for 15 to 17 (the minor's own agreement from 15, KME RS); child information and assent for younger children who can understand and express a view (groupings below 15 chosen per study and justified in K1; no fixed national bands). Re-consent version at 18 (SI-PT-main or SI-PT-healthy). Recruitment material addressed to parents, children or adolescents (SI-K2); separate optional-consent material for future use (secondary_use).

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_participant information and assent_<population>_SI_sl

population_sets.note: Article 31 conditions; legally designated representative with verified legal authority (Patients' Rights Act, Article 37). Participant information or assent suited to the participant's understanding. Direct re-consent with SI-PT-main when capacity is regained. Impartial-witness section if the representative can consent but cannot write. The capacity-assessment and representative-verification procedure is a site-file and consent-process document, not a CTIS participant document (K1 v110).

Only when every Article 35 condition and the approved protocol are met. Concise participant information sheet for use as soon as the participant can receive information; subsequent participant information and consent (what occurred before consent, choices now, withdrawal and data use, right to object to the use of data); legally designated representative information and consent when the participant remains unable to consent. Impartial-witness section if a person can consent but cannot write. Not an ordinary adult ICF without emergency-specific explanation. No Slovenian national emergency-consent form or waiver exists (DECISIONS.md D12).

Participant or legally designated representative who can consent but cannot write (Article 29). Not for interpreter needs, accessible-signature cases, lack of capacity or an unavailable representative. The KME RS generic consent form has no witness block; add a compliant witness section when the pathway is foreseeable, before approval (DECISIONS.md D13).

KME RS guidance (point 12): written pregnancy and fetal-risk information and contraception instructions where teratogenic risk exists; women of childbearing potential sign an acknowledgment that they understood it and will avoid pregnancy for the risk period; the same warning signed by healthy female partners of male participants when relevant. Not a substitute for informed consent: the risk, follow-up, privacy and withdrawal information stays in the PIS. Separate document or signed section of the main ICF (DECISIONS.md D10).

Dedicated Slovenian information and consent form, or a clearly separate approved section, when pregnancy follow-up goes beyond the main trial information (DECISIONS.md D11). Article 33 conditions when pregnant or breastfeeding women are intentionally included. A separate medical-record release or clinician-contact authorisation if needed.

The pregnant partner is a separate person and data subject; the trial participant cannot consent on her behalf. Direct Slovenian information and consent before collecting identifiable records, contacting her clinician or conducting pregnancy or infant follow-up, unless a specific legal safety-reporting obligation permits a narrower collection. Contact her directly, not through the participant.

Infant or child follow-up information and representative permission when follow-up continues after birth; explain whose data are processed, who gives permission and each follow-up period. Maternal consent is not unlimited permission for future research involving the child.

Separate Slovenian form or clearly separated optional section with its own choice and signature (DECISIONS.md D14). Trial participation, optional data processing and optional sample use separated in the document and records. Refusal does not block main-trial participation. Parent or representative versions for minors and adults unable to consent; the participant's own decision at adulthood or regained capacity.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which documents a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents. Every template is "missing": none was supplied.

population_rules.authority: KME RS (national ethics committee, Part II assessment) and JAZMP; Regulation implementing the EU Clinical Trials Regulation (Official Gazette RS No 132/2022, Articles 5, 7, 10 and 14); Patients' Rights Act (Official Gazette RS No 15/2008, Articles 35 and 37); KME RS Instructions for Preparing Applications for Ethical Assessment, 3 March 2020 (points 10 to 13); Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35; as recorded in the Slovenia guides reviewed 23 September 2026.
population_rules.template_status: missing: no Slovenian participant templates were supplied. Every template id below is a planned id from participant_templates_missing, with no file ("template": "missing" in population_sets).

age_bands.basis: Patients' Rights Act, Article 35: a child under 15 is presumed unable to consent to healthcare unless the doctor considers the child sufficiently mature. No fixed national leaflet bands below 15 were identified in current JAZMP or KME RS CTIS guidance; choose defensible age and maturity groupings and explain them in K1 (DECISIONS.md D15).
age_bands.condition: child can understand and express a view

age_bands.basis: Patients' Rights Act, Article 35 (a child aged 15 or older is presumed able to consent to healthcare unless the doctor finds otherwise) and KME RS guidance, point 11 (invited minors aged 15 or older provide their own agreement in addition to parent or representative consent). The legally designated representative still gives the legally effective trial consent until 18.

minors.band_conflict: None with templates (none supplied). The national healthcare-consent presumption at 15 and the CTR are combined, not in conflict: representative consent for every minor, plus the minor's own agreement from 15.
minors.representatives: Confirm who has legal authority for the particular child under Slovenian law and the family circumstances; a person accompanying the child is not automatically authorised. If the representative changes, document the new authority and determine whether fresh consent is needed. The guides do not state whether one or two parental signatures are needed (DECISIONS.md D16).
minors.assent_dissent: Information through a person trained or experienced in working with children; assent omitted not because the child is below a sponsor-created band when the child can understand and express a view; an explicit refusal or wish to withdraw of a minor capable of forming an opinion is respected and a representative's signature does not erase dissent. Avoid phrases suggesting that a parent has already decided.
minors.staged_assent: Move to a more mature information document when a child's understanding changes materially, if the approved package provides for staged assent.
minors.reconsent_at_18: SI-PT-main or SI-PT-healthy: express informed consent before continued participation; do not rely indefinitely on the earlier representative consent.
minors.adolescent_privacy: Explain what information parents or representatives will receive and what may stay confidential within the limits of law, safety and the protocol; no promise of absolute confidentiality from parents.

adults_without_capacity.note: Capacity is decision-specific and can change. Legally designated representative with documented authority (Patients' Rights Act, Article 37; where no representative exists the healthcare provider informs the competent authority for appointment). An explicit refusal or resistance of a participant capable of forming an opinion is respected; silence, passivity or inability to sign is not agreement. Participant's own express consent with SI-PT-main when capacity is regained; for fluctuating capacity, document each assessment and avoid burdensome repeated consent. No vague, unlimited future use authorised by the representative.

emergency.note: Article 35 applied directly; no Slovenian national emergency-consent form or broader waiver. Later participant consent even if a representative consented to continuation. Record date and time carefully. Refusal stops further trial-specific intervention and follow-up except necessary and lawful safety actions.

impartial_witness.note: Witness statement confirming personal observation that the information was accurately explained, the person appeared to understand it, questions were answered, the decision was made freely and the consent expressed matched the record. A representative who cannot write needs the witness section in the representative document (DECISIONS.md D13).

reproductive_risk.note: Applies when reproductive.teratogenic_risk is true: women of childbearing potential and, when relevant, healthy female partners of male participants (KME RS guidance, point 12).

pregnancy.participant: SI-PT-pregnancy when follow-up goes beyond the main trial information
pregnancy.partner: SI-PT-pregnant-partner whenever data are collected from or about the pregnant partner
pregnancy.infant: SI-PT-infant when follow-up continues after birth

healthy_volunteers.screening: SI-PT-screening when invasive procedures or identifiable health-data collection begin before main consent

secondary_use.note: Separate choice for each optional purpose (future disease research, optional genetic or biomarker analysis, sharing with academic or commercial collaborators, biobank or reusable database, future contact, record linkage, leftover samples). The KME RS model statement on anonymised scientific use is narrow and is not permission for identifiable, pseudonymised, genetic, commercial or unlimited future use.

separate_document_rules: Healthy volunteers and patients in one protocol get separate or clearly population-specific documents.
Emergency enrolment uses emergency-specific documents, not an ordinary adult ICF.
Optional future data or sample use has a separate form or clearly separated optional section with its own choice and signature; refusal must not block main-trial participation.
The pregnant partner receives her own document; the enrolled participant cannot consent on her behalf.
Genuinely optional activities (future research samples, optional genetic work, contact for other studies, pregnancy-partner follow-up) have separate statements and signature boxes.
Re-consent when an approved change affects the basis of participation or legal status changes: reaching 18, regained capacity, a new optional research use or material new safety information.

drafting_rules: Participant documents are in Slovenian: natural Slovenian terminology, short sentences, technical terms defined; clear, short, respectful, empathetic and lay-friendly information (KME RS); no unreviewed literal translation; reviewed by a competent native-language clinical reviewer.

The PIS and ICF may be one integrated document or two coordinated documents; either way the title, protocol identifier, EU trial number, population, version, date and site contact details match, and optional activities are not hidden inside one general agreement.

Trial identity and purpose: full and plain-language title, sponsor, protocol number, EU trial number, reason for the research, investigational treatment, comparison, why the person is invited; make clear it is research and what differs from ordinary care.

Procedures, visits and duration: screening, randomisation, blinding, treatment, placebo or comparator, visits, hospital stays, samples, imaging, questionnaires, devices, follow-up and participant responsibilities, with realistic time commitments; identify research-only procedures.

Risks, burdens and safety: reasonably foreseeable adverse effects, procedural, reproductive and genetic risks, inconvenience, pain, travel, time and uncertainty; safety checks, emergency contacts, discontinuation rules and when the investigator or sponsor may stop participation.

Teratogenic or reproductive risk: specific written information on pregnancy and fetal risk, contraception and the period during which pregnancy must be avoided, with the KME RS signed acknowledgment (population set reproductive_risk_acknowledgment).

Benefits and alternatives: no implied personal benefit when none is expected; possible direct benefit, benefit to future patients and uncertainty; reasonable alternatives including standard care; what happens to ordinary healthcare after refusal or withdrawal.

Voluntariness and withdrawal: refusal or withdrawal without giving a reason and without loss of appropriate healthcare or damage to the relationship with the treating physician; which activities stop, what safety follow-up may still be requested, what happens to samples and why some data must be retained.

Privacy: controllers and processors, data collected, purposes, recipients, source-record access, coding or pseudonymisation, international transfers, safeguards, retention and rights; state when complete deletion cannot be promised; never present trial consent as the legal basis for all processing (Information Commissioner).

Biological samples: required samples, purpose, tests, coding, storage, transfers, access, destruction or retention, genetic analysis, incidental findings and withdrawal limits; optional future use as a separate choice.

Compensation, expenses and insurance: travel reimbursement, meals, accommodation, payment, schedule and what happens after early withdrawal, without improper pressure; care and compensation for trial-related injury with a practical contact route, matching the proof of sponsor and investigator liability cover; no broader promises than the policy supports.

Results, new information and contacts: whether and how overall results will be available, how new information is communicated, whether individual findings are returned; name, role, address and telephone number of the investigator or qualified contact for questions and urgent medical advice; the trial and participant-rights contacts KME RS expects (national contact points listed on the KME RS page: JAZMP, KME RS, patient-rights representatives, the Human Rights Ombudsman, the Information Commissioner) with current official details, never copied from an old template.

Consent section: separate statements that the participant received and understood the written and oral information, could ask questions and received satisfactory answers, had enough time, understands voluntariness and the right to withdraw without reason or harm to ordinary care, agrees to the defined trial procedures, understands the injury and insurance information and receives a signed and dated copy; separate statements and signature boxes for genuinely optional activities.

Signature blocks: participant or legally designated representative and the person conducting the interview, each with printed name, signature and date; witness, adolescent-agreement and representative blocks only in the pathway where they apply; two copies, one for the participant and one for the trial archive (KME RS).
Blank documents in CTIS with version number and date; no signatures or personal data.
Avoid coercive, reassuring, promotional or liability-waiving language; explain probabilities in plain language with consistent denominators.

Participant templates were not supplied; where a reference document or a later template is used, its instructions ([square-bracket] notes, italic notes, '...........' gaps) and the Part II form instructions (yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: …] labels) are drafting instructions; none may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.slovenia_note: Use the CTCG pattern. The Slovenia guides use descriptive document names and give no national naming instruction. _SI_sl on participant-facing documents, _SI on O1, P1, P2, R1 and S1. The cover letter, synopsis, P2 financing description and fee proof carry proposed titles to confirm (DECISIONS.md D6, D7, D9).

sources_note: All 11 Slovenia guide pages reviewed 23 September 2026, read 27 November 2026. '#n' after SI-PII-CHECKLIST is the item number on that page. Supplied: CTIS_SI Part II DOCX set (K1, M1, M2, N1, P1, R1, S1) and the Slovenian variable sheet, compared with the shared forms; no Slovenian participant templates.
